claim_is_not: s_Q^NO(v103) <= 10. That stronger claim is FALSE for this state and was the error the superseded artifact records: s_Q^NO needs a 1-RDM exactly equal to diag(lambda), and this one is not diagonal.
note_on_the_superseded_file: That file is retained deliberately as documented history. The state in it is correct; only the claim attached to it was wrong.
why_s_Q_free_and_not_s_Q_NO: The 1-RDM has two nonzero off-diagonal entries, rho[3,9] = -5/68 and rho[1,6] = -sqrt(42)/221. So the state attains the spectrum in a basis other than the natural-orbital one, and its support bounds s_Q^free. The s_Q^NO bound for this vertex remains the library value 14.
